semiconductor_relevance: High — Fermion Technology specializes in high-end instruments and equipment crucial for the research and preparation of advanced electronic materials used in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Fermion Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides high-end instruments and equipment for the research, preparation, and measurement of advanced electronic materials. With a focus on independent research and development, the company has developed expertise in ultra-high vacuum systems, temperature control, thin film preparation, and plasma technology, serving both domestic and international clients.
capabilities: Ultra-high vacuum systems for semiconductor processing
Temperature control equipment for precise material preparation
Plasma technology solutions for material treatment

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and serves both domestic and international clients.
